lines.text: The roads into {settlement} arrive from more directions than the town has business for, and all of them end in the same square.
stop: town square ("all of them end in the same square")

lines.text: {settlement} is used to strangers and has priced accordingly.
More passes through {settlement} than stops in it, and the town takes its living from the difference.
{settlement} sits where the roads meet and has stayed small about it; the traffic goes through, and the town has never tried to hold it.

keyGuarantees: config.tradeRouteAccess port on non-riverside terrain (waterAccessKind maritime: coast)
pools.ruling: Not scoped: suppressed under any record crisis.

lines.text: {settlement} shows you its water before it shows you its buildings.
Work in {settlement} runs on the tide rather than the sun, and the town's hours are strange to anyone from inland.
{settlement}'s wharves are the town's real ground; what happens on the land is arranged around what happens at the quay.
{settlement} has a harbour and uses very little of it. What the water could bring, the town has not found a reason to want.

keyGuarantees: config.tradeRouteAccess river, or port on riverside terrain (waterAccessKind river)
pools.ruling: Not scoped: suppressed under any record crisis.

lines.text: {settlement} is laid along its water rather than around a square, and you meet it lengthwise.
Everything in {settlement} is upstream or downstream of something else, and the town gives directions that way.
The barge traffic sets {settlement}'s calendar; what the river cannot carry in season, {settlement} does without.
{settlement} sits on navigable water and ships almost nothing on it; the river here is a boundary the town lives beside rather than a road it uses.

pools.ruling: Not scoped: suppressed under any record crisis.

lines.text: You see {settlement}'s smoke a long time before you see {settlement}.
{settlement} is a long way from anywhere and has arranged itself on that assumption.
What reaches {settlement} reaches it deliberately; nothing arrives here by passing through.
{settlement} is remote and not isolated: the road is bad and it is kept, and the keeping is somebody's standing decision.

keyGuarantees: config.tradeRouteAccess road or any unlisted/absent route
pools.ruling: Not scoped: suppressed under any record crisis.

lines.text: {settlement} announces itself the way a working town does, which is barely.
{settlement} is on the way to somewhere and has made a modest living out of being on the way.
Goods come into {settlement} and goods go out of it, and neither the coming nor the going is remarkable.
The road runs past {settlement} and {settlement} takes very little from it; the traffic is real and the town has stayed outside it.
